articles.summary: IRVINE, Calif. (Apr. 11, 2023) – American Healthcare REIT, Inc. (the "Company"), a self-managed, publicly registered, real estate investment trust, announced today that independent directors Harold ("Hal") H. Greene, Gerald ("Bill") W. Robinson and J. Grayson Sanders will retire from the Company’s board of directors (the “Board”) effective as of June 14, 2023 and therefore will not stand for re-election.
articles.title: American Healthcare REIT Announces Retirement of Three Independent Directors in Connection with Board Refreshment
